p: Welcome to Gooyoit Passport ("the service"). The service provides unified registration, sign-in, identity verification, and authorization for connected applications. By accessing or using the service you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these terms.
We may revise these terms at any time; revisions take effect once published on this page. Continued use after publication constitutes acceptance.
The service is available to individuals and organizations able to enter into legally binding contracts. Minors may use the service only with the consent and supervision of a parent or legal guardian.
You may sign in with a phone number and SMS code, an email address and password, WeChat QR code, or a Passkey. Your phone number and email identify your account; keep them accurate.
If you sign in with WeChat and have not yet linked a phone number or email, you must complete that link before continuing to a connected application.
You are responsible for your credentials, SMS codes, and Passkey. Actions taken through your account are presumed to be yours.

You must not use the service for unlawful activity; attack, scan, or attempt to bypass the security controls of the service or connected applications; abuse shared resources such as SMS codes or human verification; or sign in under another person's identity.
We may rate-limit, suspend, or terminate access in response to anomalous traffic, bulk registration, or credential stuffing, and may report unlawful activity to the authorities.

We make commercially reasonable efforts to keep the service stable but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. We are not liable for interruptions caused by network failures, third-party outages, or force majeure.
The service may change, pause, or end as our business evolves; material changes will be announced through connected applications or the account settings page.
We collect and process personal information in accordance with the Privacy Policy. Using the service indicates your acceptance of that policy.
We may suspend or terminate your access if you breach these terms or engage in conduct that endangers account security or abuses shared resources.
You may unlink sign-in methods in account settings or contact us to delete your account. After deletion we remove or anonymize your personal information, except where law requires retention.
You are responsible for losses caused by failing to safeguard credentials, sharing verification codes, or signing in from an insecure environment.
To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect losses arising from the use or inability to use the service.

These terms are governed by the laws of mainland China. Disputes will first be addressed through good-faith negotiation; failing that, either party may bring the matter before a court with jurisdiction.
If you have questions about these terms, please contact us through the administrator of your connected application.
Phone number: stored after SMS verification, used to identify your account and for SMS sign-in.
Email and password: used for email sign-in. Signing in with an unregistered email creates an account for that address.
Third-party identity: when you sign in with WeChat we receive the open identifier, display name, and avatar returned by WeChat, used to link your account.
Sign-in logs: for account security we record sign-in time, IP address, sign-in method, and authorization history.
All of this is used only for verification, sign-in, account security, and auditing — never for advertising.
The service uses a single session cookie (passport_sso) required to keep you signed in. It is HttpOnly and is never used for behavioural tracking or cross-site advertising.
If you select "Stay signed in for 7 days", the cookie lasts 7 days; otherwise it expires when the browser closes.
Clearing cookies in your browser signs you out.
We do not sell your personal information. Only when you sign in to a connected application do we pass it basic identity data (user ID, display name, avatar).
When you sign in with WeChat, Tencent processes the related authorization data under its own privacy policy.
We do not share, transfer, or disclose your information to other third parties except as required by law or with your consent.
We use encrypted transport, hashed password storage, SMS and captcha rate limits, and login lockouts.
The internet is not perfectly secure. Never share your SMS codes, password, or Passkey.
If a security incident affects your data, we will notify you and report it as required by law.

sections.h: 5. Where and how long we store it
p: Your personal information is stored on servers located in mainland China.
Transient data — SMS codes, login codes, authorization codes — is deleted as soon as it expires.
After account deletion we remove or anonymize your personal information, except for network logs that law requires us to retain.
You can review and manage sign-in methods (phone, email, password, WeChat, Passkey) in account settings.
You can correct your username or email, unlink third-party accounts, or contact us to delete your account.
Questions about how we handle your information can go to the administrator of your connected application.
If you have questions about this policy, please contact us through the administrator of your connected application.
